item.title: How one negative google review led to the New Bedford Whaling museum to go viral
item.description: After a a Google user left a one-star review of the New Bedford Whaling Museum, calling it the "worst Aquarium Ever" the museum created merch with the phrase on it that has gone viral.

item.title: A volunteer's unexpected advice changed how she faced cancer
item.description: After Annabelle Gurwitch was diagnosed with Stage 4 lung cancer, a volunteer with the same diagnosis encouraged her to stop worrying so much about the future and start living again.

item.title: 'It's just so fun to make people laugh,' says 'Hacks' star Jean Smart
item.description: The fifth and final season of the HBO Max series Hacks is nominated for 24 Emmys, including one for Smart as best actress in a comedy series. The writers "raised the bar every single season," Smart says.

item.title: 'Country People' is a silly, satisfying midsummer romp
item.description: Daniel Mason's new novel is a spin on Shakespeare's A Midsummer Night's Dream, in which academics collide with locals — and a few seductive fairies — in the woods of Vermont.

item.title: 13 new books in August will get you through the dog days of summer
item.description: This month brings riveting novels about dogs, Hollywood stars, small towns and characters with bigger woes than just the sweltering summer heat and humidity.

item.title: How the Miss America pageant ignited a battle over beauty, race and power
item.description: Historian Micki McElya revisits one September afternoon in 1968, Atlantic City, when the Miss America pageant collided with a changing country. Her new book is Liberation Summer.

item.title: 'Stuart Fails to Save the Universe' is a fun and familiar 'Big Bang' spin-off
item.description: A 10-part HBO Max spin-off to The Big Bang Theory expands on that long-running sitcom by following a quartet of its characters. Every episode offers a new multiverse — and surprising cameos.

item.title: Over 4 million people are no longer receiving food aid amid sweeping changes to SNAP
item.description: SNAP, also known as food stamps, has seen a rapid and consistent participation decline since last July. The drop comes as the program faces historic cuts and changes.
